data.fund_type: An open-ended exchange traded fund tracking price of silver
data.investment_objective: The investment objective of the scheme is to generate returns that are in line with the performance of physical silver in domestic prices, subject to tracking error. However, there is no guarantee or assurance that the investment objective of the scheme would be achieved.
data.asset_allocation: Silver and / or silver related instruments# 95%-100%
data.benchmark: Domestic price of silver (based on LBMA Silver daily spot fixing price)
